name: Sublime Strike
legend: When an Emperor’s Children boarding party attacks, its warriors aim to humiliate the enemy by demonstrating their glaring superiority. What need of massed onslaught or brute force have the scions of Fulgrim when a mere handful of their best warriors can seize and destroy the enemy’s command bridge, their enginarium, or whatever vital target will bring swift and total victory? By moving quickly and employing the full gamut of their dark gifts, the warriors of a boarding party take the enemy out of the fight with a single, expertly aimed blow.

rules.name: Dark Radiance
rules.legend: So potent is the disdainful arrogance of these Slaaneshi chosen that it manifests as a Warp-tainted aura that blinds and cows even the most obdurate enemies, forcing them to give way before the advance of the Emperor’s Children like unworthy dregs.
rules.description_html: Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in that unit can move through friendly and enemy models.

stratagems.name: VYING FOR VICTORY
stratagems.legend: Sweeping their enemies aside almost as an afterthought, these warriors press on with all haste, obsessed with staying ahead of their rivals within the boarding party.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

stratagems.name: EAGER FOR MORE
stratagems.legend: Never sated, no matter the ferocity of the fight, the Emperor's Children maintain a manic momentum as they drive toward their primary target at a breakneck pace.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

stratagems.name: ALLURING GROTESQUERIE
stratagems.legend: Physically and spiritually distorted by the blessings of Slaanesh, these warriors can project an aura that fascinates and revolts their enemies on a level so instinctual that it drives some to madness.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: CLOYING CORRUPTION
stratagems.legend: The mere presence of these Slaaneshi chosen is enough to taint the fabric of reality, saturating it with lingering spiritual corruption.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One FLAWLESS BLADES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

enhancements.name: Venom of the Six-fanged Serpent
enhancements.legend: This preening Slaaneshi champion has anointed their weapons with corrosive hyperstimulants milked from the maw of a foul daemonic entity. The merest drop can burn out the nervous systems of their victims with flash floods of unbearable sensation.
enhancements.description_html: Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2.

enhancements.name: Daemonshrieker
enhancements.legend: Carved with imprisoning runes and bristling with needle barbs, this vile device houses a bound Slaaneshi daemon. Through agonising ritual surgery, it is implanted into the throat of a chosen champion, allowing them to channel the trapped entity’s desperate rage into blasting war shouts that can shatter any barred gateway or locked hatch.
enhancements.description_html: In your Shooting phase, you can select one closed Hatchway within 12" of and visible to the bearer. If you do, roll one D6: on a 2+, open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.
